entities.summary: Grace Omaboe, popularly known as Maame Dɔkono, is a Ghanaian actress, singer, and television personality. She ran the former Peace and Love Orphanage, now Graceful Grace school in Accra. Omaboe and others were honored by the organizers of the 3Music Awards for their achievements in the entertainment industry in Ghana.
